To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the user's current information interest can be efficiently and incrementally mined by mining the content of the folders of interest; (2) the mined specification is more precise than the user's specification, and is more comprehensible than the specification mined by existing techniques, and thus is more useful in web scanning
we have designed a system to incrementally mine the interest specification from a folder hierarchy and then apply the specification to scan the Web for new information of interest.

(i) a user can maintain his/her folders, which may be constantly evolving over time, and then get IOI by constantly scanning the web; (ii) the user's current interests are specified as context in conjunctive form, which is more comprehensible and precise; (iii) the user may thus maintain the folders and then constantly scan the web, without paying much effort to interest specification or seed identification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues.
the incremental mining of information interests from the user's information folder structure, and the resulting specifications are used for the continuous scanning of the Internet.

the problem of how to incrementally mine the user's current information interests from his/her information folders, and how to use such interests to direct web scanning for personalized information retrieval.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our technique is able to incrementally mine the user's information interest from his/her folder hierarchy and provide him/her with a precise and comprehensible specification of the interest for web scanning, which is also understandable by information providers.
we have developed a novel incremental text mining technique that is able to efficiently mine the user's current interests by mining the user folders.

our approach is able to incrementally mine the user's current information interest from the user's information folder hierarchy, and to provide a precise and comprehensible specification for the interest.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel technique to automatically extract a user's interest specification from his/her information folders.
we have developed an incremental text mining method that can automatically identify the user's interest from his/her information folders, which can then be used to direct the web scanning process.
the incremental mining of interest specification is a promising approach to personalized web scanning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user's IOI can be mined to provide a natural and precise specification for web scanning.
, with the aid of text mining, we may be able to provide users with a new way to specify their interest, so as to facilitate the continuous scanning of the web for their IOI.
we have developed an incremental technique that can efficiently identify the context of an interest type, which can then be used to direct a web crawler to scan the web for IOI.
